design_rationale_and_evaluation: Largest fully-connected location in the entire dataset: 417 adults in a single 50 m mating pool, BL1. 22 mothers in DB. Predicted pollen compatibility 0.779, close to the species mean 0.778.

Small, fragmented BL1 location: 22 adults across 3 mating pools, largest-pool share 0.50 — the lowest BL1 connectivity at ≥ 7 mothers. 8 mothers in DB. Predicted pollen compatibility 0.740 — the lowest predicted BL1 value at usable mother counts. **EVALUATION: strongest within-BL confound control AND the largest within-BL predicted P_compat gap (0.039). Recommended when the goal is to isolate the fragmentation × size axis from between-BL differences in Ne, connectivity history, or BL selection pressure. Within-BL1 means both sites share the same evolutionary context, so any observed deviation is a within-BL fragmentation signal rather than between-BL noise.**
Same big + connected anchor as B1 (417 adults, 1 pool, 22 mothers, pred 0.779).

Small, fragmented BL1 location: 34 adults across 3 mating pools, largest-pool share 0.71. 14 mothers in DB. Predicted P_compat 0.754. **EVALUATION: more mothers than EO26-2_35 (14 vs 8), so smaller sampling-noise penalty, but the connectivity share (0.71 vs 0.50) is less fragmented than EO26-2_35 and the predicted P_compat gap shrinks from 0.039 to 0.025. Use B2 if mother count matters more than contrast sharpness.**
Same big + connected anchor as B1 and B2 (BL1, 417 adults, 1 pool, 22 mothers, pred 0.779).

Smallest BL5 location with ≥ 7 mothers in DB: 10 adults across 2 mating pools, both below the N=8 species-pool threshold. 7 mothers in DB. Predicted P_compat 0.728 — the lowest predicted value in the entire ≥ 7-mother set. **EVALUATION: delivers the largest predicted P_compat gap (0.051) and the biggest size ratio (42×) of any usable pair. Confounds fragmentation × BL identity: BL1 (big+connected anchor) and BL5 (drift-sensitive partner) have different evolutionary histories, so an observed deviation at EO25-B_21 cannot be cleanly attributed to fragmentation alone. Use B3 when the P_compat gap is more important than confound control, or when BL identity is treated as a cluster label rather than a biological covariate.**
